description:
A thought-provoking and inspiring Joint Club Speaker Meet, hosted by Rotary Club of Queens Necklace, with Rotary Clubs of Bombay North, Bombay Pier, Hanging Gardens, Bombay Metropolitan and Bombay Bayview as co-hosts, featured Mr. Tukaram Mundhe, Commissioner, Food & Drug Administration, Mah, YBChavan

Speaking on “Why Me? – From Why Me to Why Can’t I”, Mr. Mundhe shared his remarkable journey from humble beginnings to securing 20th rank in the UPSC, highlighting resilience, self-belief and integrity.

His message was powerful: While “Why me?” is a natural response to adversity, we must ask, “Why can’t I?” Why can’t I dream, compete, seek justice and make a difference?

He emphasised that true poverty can also be a poverty of ideas, values and ethics. He spoke passionately about honesty in public service, food and drug safety, and importance of supporting ethical, compliant businesses.

His call to action: ASK. READ. REPORT.

An enriching evening that inspired 56 Members & 10 Partners
